messages.text: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

A non-signaling tester is evidenced here as an RF measurement tester used in non-signaling mode, especially in production where WLAN RF measurements are run in non-signaling mode to save time; the R&S example is the R&S CMP180, which is described as optimized for that purpose [25].
A signaling tester is evidenced by the R&S CMX500, which Raw evidence calls a “5G one-box signaling tester” [65] and a “multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester” with Wi‑Fi 8 testing capabilities [66].
R&S positions the CMX500 for Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling and interworking testing, while it positions the CMP180 for production non-signaling RF testing [26].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is described as needing signaling mode and real-world RF TX/RX characteristic measurements [24].
WLAN production testing is described as running all RF measurements in non-signaling mode to save time [25].
The CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing [9].
The CMP180 is a radio communication tester for production and wireless communication device testing with RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and VSE analysis capability [1].
CMX500 signaling options include WLAN signaling options such as R&S CMX-KS350B, CMX-KS351B, CMX-KS352B, CMX-KS353B, CMX-KS355B, CMX-KS356B, CMX-KS357B, CMX-KS360B and CMX-KS365B [62].
CMX500 also has WLAN TX measurement options for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and True MIMO [61].
CMP180 measurement options include non-cellular measurements pack R&S CMP-PKM30, cellular measurements pack R&S CMP-PKM40, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE and NR FR1 measurement options [7].
CMP180 waveform options include non-cellular waveforms R&S CMP-PKV30, cellular waveforms R&S CMP-PKV40, GPRF, GNSS, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE and NR waveform options [4].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing with CMX500 is tied to MLO, multiple RF chains and 2x2 MIMO test capabilities [24].
CMP180 is described as integrating two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [25].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [25].
CMX500 is described as supporting application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS, audio and POLQA [11].
CMX500 is also described as having an integrated N3IWF gateway for WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN and an integrated POLQA voice-quality measurement function for early quality-of-experience evaluation [28].
The CMP180 production evidence given here is RF-measurement-focused, not application or voice-quality-focused [25].
Raw evidence says R&S and Broadcom will display the CMX500 at MWC Barcelona 2026 with newly added Wi‑Fi 8 IEEE 802.11bn testing capabilities for validating a prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device [66].
CMP180 evidence says it will demonstrate loopback validation of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform described as a potential candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 or IEEE 802.11bn, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [25].
【推論】If the measurement task requires network emulation, signaling mode, interworking or application behavior, the cited product evidence points to CMX500 rather than CMP180 [9][24][26][28][65][66].
【推論】If the measurement task is high-throughput production RF testing without signaling, the cited product evidence points to CMP180 rather than CMX500 [25][26].
【推論】If the purchase decision is about options, the signaling-versus-non-signaling distinction determines whether to start from CMX500 signaling options such as CMX-KS options or CMP180 measurement and waveform options such as CMP-PKM, CMP-KM and CMP-KV options [4][7][62].

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › Warranty and service
依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

- Base unit warranty：1 year。
- All other items warranty：1 year。
- Service plans：on demand up to five years；extended periods require contacting Rohde & Schwarz sales office。
- Calibration：pay per calibration。
- Warranty and repair：up to five years，standard price repair。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › Waveform 與 R&S WinIQSIM2 options
依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，CMP180 支援 waveform creator、standard-specific waveform playback 與 [[R&S VSE]] analysis options。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] ordering information，software predefined waveform options 包括：

- Non-cellular waveforms for ARB generator pack 1：R&S CMP-PKV30，1212.3708.02。
- Cellular waveforms for ARB generator pack 1：R&S CMP-PKV40，1212.3714.02。
- GPRF waveforms：R&S CMP-KV210，1212.4427.02。
- GNSS waveforms：R&S CMP-KV220，1212.2330.02。
- NB-IoT waveforms：R&S CMP-KV250，1212.2347.02。
- LP-IoT waveforms, Zigbee / SigFox：R&S CMP-KV280，1212.2353.02。
- UWB production waveforms：R&S CMP-KV305，1212.4327.02。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

R&S CMX500 OBT › 來源中的定位
[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]] 將 license swap 流程描述為 `License swap for OBT upgrades`，並以：

- Unit A：[[R&S CMW500]]。

來表示從 CMW500 setup 升級到 CMX500 OBT 時的 keycode transfer target。

來源短版流程另寫明：Customers who upgrade their Setup2 to CMX500 OBT，R&S offers a license swap CMW500 → CMX500。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 描述為 CMX500 one-box signaling tester（OBT），可在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中讓 developers 進行 realistic [[MIMO]] stress tests。該來源明確說 [[Bluetest]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software，並讓 developers 使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 描述為 state-of-the-art one-box signaling tester，用於展示基於 [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications 的 [[5G NTN-NR]] connection。該來源說展示 setup 使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[MediaTek]] 的 NTN-NR device as DUT，並在 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 的 Rohde & Schwarz booth 展示 live 5G NTN-NR connection。

R&S CMX500 OBT › Bluetest RTS / OTA test 語境
依 [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 可與 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）及 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 搭配。
- 支援使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 Bluetest RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。
- [[Bluetest]] 也將較早的 [[WLAN]] stations / access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）integrated testing capabilities 擴充到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 320 MHz bandwidth support。
- 來源將此整合定位為 single tester and reverberation test system 的 multi-technology validation path。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]：

- 展示使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[MediaTek]] 的 NTN-NR device as DUT。
- 展示內容為 live [[5G NTN-NR]] connection，emulating a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] radio communication tester 在 setup 中 simulate the satellite base station。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator 在 setup 中以 integrated GNSS option simulate the different satellite constellations。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 會 operate in an interactive callbox mode，allowing users to trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。
- 來源定位此 test mode 為評估 future NTN-NR devices powered by [[MediaTek]] NTN test platform 在不同條件下的 5G connection performance and reliability。

此段只可作為 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 展示 / PR 層級證據；不能取代 [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 或 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]。

R&S CMX500 OBT

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › 硬體架構摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] hardware architecture 為 modular and scalable，front panel 與 rear panel 有 optional hardware units 的 slots。
- Standard hardware configurations 名稱包含 one box tester（OBT）：
  - **OBT**：2 RF units、2 IF units（optional）、3 AU。
  - **OBT lite**：1 RF unit、1 IF unit（optional）、1 AU。
  - **OBT plus**：3 RF units、2 IF units（optional）、2 AU。
  - **OBT FR1 specialist**：4 RF units、0 IF units、2 或 3 AU。
  - **OBT FR2 specialist**：1 RF unit、4 IF units、2 AU。
- 其他 hardware unit 組合也可行，總數最多 **7 units**（accelerator units + RF units + IF units）。
- Hardware units 組合限制：必須有 **1 到 4 accelerator units**、**0 到 4 IF units**、**0 到 4 RF units**。
- RF unit 支援 **400 MHz 到 8 GHz**，由 **4 TX** 與 **2 RX modules** 組成；每個 TX 支援最高 **200 MHz total carrier bandwidth**，分布於最高 **1 GHz instantaneous bandwidth（iBW）**；每個 RX 支援最高 **500 MHz bandwidth**。
- RF unit 有 **8 個 RF connectors**：4 個 RF Out、2 個 RF In、2 個 RF Com。
- RF unit 最大允許 carriers 數量為 **8（8CC）**。
- IF unit 加上 [[R&S CMXHEAD]] remote radio head 支援 NR FR2 frequencies；每個 IF unit 支援 **1 TRX**，最高 **800 MHz total carrier bandwidth**，分布於最高 **1 GHz iBW**。
- 不使用 remote radio head 時，IF frequencies 最高 **20 GHz**；搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] 時 RF frequencies 最高 **43.5 GHz**；搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 時 RF frequencies 最高 **50.2 GHz**。
- 每個 accelerator unit 可 fading 的最大 cells 數包含：1 NR cell 8x8 MIMO、1 NR cell 16x4 MIMO 50 MHz bandwidth、2 NR cells 4x4 MIMO、4 NR cells 2x2 MIMO、2 LTE cells 8x4 MIMO、4 LTE cells 2x2 或 4x4 MIMO。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 提供 deployment calculation service（DCS），用於選擇符合 DUT band combinations、bandwidths 與 MIMO layers 需求的 [[R&S CMX500]] configuration。

A non-signaling tester is evidenced here as an RF measurement tester used in non-signaling mode, especially in production where WLAN RF measurements are run in non-signaling mode to save time; the R&S example is the R&S CMP180, which is described as optimized for that purpose [25].
A signaling tester is evidenced by the R&S CMX500, which Raw evidence calls a “5G one-box signaling tester” [65] and a “multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester” with Wi‑Fi 8 testing capabilities [66].
R&S positions the CMX500 for Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling and interworking testing, while it positions the CMP180 for production non-signaling RF testing [26].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is described as needing signaling mode and real-world RF TX/RX characteristic measurements [24].
WLAN production testing is described as running all RF measurements in non-signaling mode to save time [25].
The CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing [9].
The CMP180 is a radio communication tester for production and wireless communication device testing with RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and VSE analysis capability [1].
CMX500 signaling options include WLAN signaling options such as R&S CMX-KS350B, CMX-KS351B, CMX-KS352B, CMX-KS353B, CMX-KS355B, CMX-KS356B, CMX-KS357B, CMX-KS360B and CMX-KS365B [62].
CMX500 also has WLAN TX measurement options for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and True MIMO [61].
CMP180 measurement options include non-cellular measurements pack R&S CMP-PKM30, cellular measurements pack R&S CMP-PKM40, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE and NR FR1 measurement options [7].
CMP180 waveform options include non-cellular waveforms R&S CMP-PKV30, cellular waveforms R&S CMP-PKV40, GPRF, GNSS, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE and NR waveform options [4].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing with CMX500 is tied to MLO, multiple RF chains and 2x2 MIMO test capabilities [24].
CMP180 is described as integrating two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [25].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [25].
CMX500 is described as supporting application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS, audio and POLQA [11].
CMX500 is also described as having an integrated N3IWF gateway for WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN and an integrated POLQA voice-quality measurement function for early quality-of-experience evaluation [28].
The CMP180 production evidence given here is RF-measurement-focused, not application or voice-quality-focused [25].
Raw evidence says R&S and Broadcom will display the CMX500 at MWC Barcelona 2026 with newly added Wi‑Fi 8 IEEE 802.11bn testing capabilities for validating a prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device [66].
CMP180 evidence says it will demonstrate loopback validation of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform described as a potential candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 or IEEE 802.11bn, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [25].
【推論】If the measurement task requires network emulation, signaling mode, interworking or application behavior, the cited product evidence points to CMX500 rather than CMP180 [9][24][26][28][65][66].
【推論】If the measurement task is high-throughput production RF testing without signaling, the cited product evidence points to CMP180 rather than CMX500 [25][26].
【推論】If the purchase decision is about options, the signaling-versus-non-signaling distinction determines whether to start from CMX500 signaling options such as CMX-KS options or CMP180 measurement and waveform options such as CMP-PKM, CMP-KM and CMP-KV options [4][7][62].

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › WLAN signaling 與 measurement
- WLAN signaling 支援 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn、AP testing、station testing、single user 2x2 MIMO、advanced encryption and authentication。
- 若相關 options 都可用，[[R&S CMX500]] 支援 simultaneous WLAN AP and station emulation。
- WLAN measurement options 支援 WLAN TX measurements：802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 True MIMO。
- WLAN measurement RF frequency 依 hardware 而定，涵蓋 2.4 GHz、4 GHz、5 GHz、6 GHz operating bands，也支援 out-of-band frequencies；802.11ax SISO input signal settings 明示 RF frequency 為 all WLAN frequency bands up to 7.125 GHz。
- WLAN measurement bandwidth 依 standard 支援 5 MHz、10 MHz、20 MHz、40 MHz、80 MHz、160 MHz、320 MHz。
